prompts.prompt: Can a customer-hosted, self-managed Looker deployment use the Gemini-powered Conversational Analytics and LookML Assistant features? Answer in one sentence.
prompts.source: plugins/analytics/skills/looker/SKILL.md - AI Features: AI features require Looker-hosted instances (Google Cloud Core). Customer-hosted deployments cannot use Gemini features.

prompts.prompt: In a Looker datagroup, if both sql_trigger and interval_trigger are configured, which one takes precedence? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/analytics/skills/looker/SKILL.md - Datagroups and Caching: Cannot combine sql_trigger and interval_trigger (interval takes precedence).

prompts.prompt: Does every Looker license come bundled with a Looker Studio license tier, and if so which one? Answer in one sentence.
prompts.source: plugins/analytics/skills/looker/SKILL.md - Looker vs Looker Studio: Each Looker license includes one Looker Studio Pro license.
